s: Mi hem happeturim miqqeriat shema ubo h' seipim: nashim vaabadim peturim miqqeriat shema, mippene shehu mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama, sheen mitzvatah ella bizman shekiba ubizman qima. Umikkol maqom, nakon hu lelammedam sheyyeqabbelu alehem ol malkut shamayim veyiqreu lepachot pasuq rishon. Veken peturin mibbirkot qeriat shema sheyyesh lahem gam ken zeman qabua, shel ereb ad netz hachamma veshel shachar — ad d' shaot kemo shennitbaer besiman n"ch. Umikkol maqom chayyabin bizkirat yetziat mitzrayim, shehu mitzvat aseh shello hazzeman gerama shemmitzvatah bayyom uballayla. Lepikak yesh lahem lebarek habberaka shennitqena al yetziat mitzrayim shehu "emet veyatztzib". Vekevan shehem chayyabim bitpillat y"ch kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (q"y) [q"v] — yesh lahem gam ken lismok geulla litpilla (veim ratzu lebarek gam shear berakot shel qeriat shema vegam pesuqe dezimra ubirkoteha — hareshut beyadam):

Qetannim peturim miqqeriat shema ap al pi sheyyesh bah qabbalat malkut shamayim, kemo sheppeturim mishshear kol hammitzvot. Vehu shello higgia lechinnuk. Veyesh omerim sheapillu higgia lechinnuk — lo hittilu al abiv lechanneko biqriat shema ubirkoteha, lepi sheen matzuy etzlo bizman qeriat shema baereb veyashen hu babboqer. Verauy linhog kassebara harishona. Uledibre hakkol chayyab lechanneko bitpilla im higgia lechinnuk, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"v:

Hakkones et habbetula patur miqqeriat shema ubirkoteha umin hattepilla (ayyen siman q"v) kol g' yamim achar kenisato lachuppa im lo asa maaseh, mippene shehu tarud bemachashabto tirdat mitzva shemmechashsheb al eseq habbetulim. Veg' yamim ellu hem lebad miyyom hachuppa, kegon im hayeta hachuppa beyom d' — patur miqqeriat shema millel d' ad lel motzae shabbat velo ad biklal, mippene shelleachar g' yamim kebar nitqorera dato veen tarud od bemachashabto. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bizman harishonim shehayu mekavvenim heteb biqriat shema, abal akshav sheggam shear bene adam enam mekavvenim karauy — gam hakkones et habbetula qore qeriat shema ubirkoteha umitpallel, kishar bene hachuppa sheenam peturim ella bishat hammishteh kemo shennitbaer besiman l"ch. Vedin shikkor liqriat shema — yitbaer besiman tz"t:

Haya oseq betzorke rabbim vehiggia zeman qeriat shema — lo yapsiq, ella yigmor isqehem veachar kak yiqra im nishar et liqrot. Bammeh debarim amurim? Baddorot harishonim shehayu oseqim immahem leshem shamayim, abal akshav en liptor miqqeriat shema ella im ken en mi sheyyishtaddel ella hu, sheaz apillu oseq behatztzalat mamonam lebad — oseq bemitzva hu velo yapsiq. Umikkol maqom, tob sheyyiqra pasuq rishon u"baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", im epshar liqrot bemaqom shehu oseq shello yitztarek lehapsiq isqehem. Veal kol panim chayyab lehazkir yetziat mitzrayim apillu leachar sheabar zeman qeriat shema, shezzo hi mitzva bipne atzmah, umitzvatah kol hayyom. Velaken leachar sheggamar isqehem — yomar ezeh parasha sheyyesh bah yetziat mitzrayim im kebar obra shaa d', sheeno omer od birkat "emet veyatztzib" kemo shennitbaer besiman n"ch:

Haya oseq baakila (apillu bisuda qetanna), o shehayu oseqim baddin (apillu bigmar din), o shehaya bammerchatz (vaapillu lehazzia bealma), o shehaya oseq betisporet, o shehaya mehappek baorot, vekol kayyotze baasaqim ellu sheyyesh lachush shemma yimshok bahem kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"b — tzarik lehapsiq veliqrot ap al pi sheyyesh shehut liqrot leachar sheyyigmor asaqim ellu, gezera shemma yimshok bahem veyaabor zeman qeriat shema. Veenah doma litpilla sheim hitchil en tzarik lehapsiq kemo sheyyitbaer sham, lepi sheqqeriat shema hu min hattora — hechemiru bah yoter, lepikak qoreah belo birkoteha, shebbirkoteha hem gam ken middibre soperim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehitchil beissur, dehaynu shehitchil leekol tok chatzi shaa laalot hashshachar, o shenniknas lammerchatz o lehistapper (o labburseqi) lahapok baorot o melaka acheret kayyotze bahen leachar sheala ammud hashshachar, sheqqodem alot hashshachar muttar likkanes lammerchatz o lehistapper apillu besamuk laalot hashshachar mammash kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"t (abal leachar sheala ammud hashshachar — asur lehitasseq bitzrakayv ad sheyyitpallel kemo sheyyitbaer sham, veepshar dehu haddin liqriat shema shehi qabbalat malkut shamayim, velo dami laakila dehaynu taama sheyyitpallel al damo[)]. Abal im hitchil behetter — en tzarik lehapsiq apillu liqrot qeriat shema, im yesh shehut liqrot leachar sheyyigmor. Veim haya mityare shemma yimshok veyaabor zeman qeriat shema upasaq veqara qeriat shema — hare zeh meshubbach, veeno domeh litpilla shehu tzorek hedyot kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"b. Veyesh omerim shehaoseq baakila tzarik lehapsiq litpillat hashshachar apillu hitchil behetter, hoil veissur akila qodem hattepilla hismikuhu al lo taaseh shebbattora, shenneemar: "lo toklu al haddam", lo toklu qodem shettitpalelu al dimkem kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"t (vekevan shetztzarik lehitpallel — tzarik gam ken liqrot qeriat shema ubirkoteha, kede lismok geulla litpilla).
